svg.text: TOKEIRA · ARCHITECTURE
The hot path, instrumented
One mutation's synchronous latency, stage by stage — no proportions asserted, no numbers claimed: every stage names the metric that measures it on your cluster.
THE STAGES — EQUAL BOXES, BECAUSE THE SHAPE IS YOURS TO MEASURE
1 · Edge admission
Interceptors first — authn, authz, namespace, request-id —
then the routing lookup: a lock-free snapshot read, no DSQL.
tokeira_edge_grpc_request_duration_seconds
tokeira_edge_authorization_duration_seconds
tokeira_runtime_not_shard_owner_total
2 · Submit + the lane channel
Drain and Active gates, blake3 lane pick, the bounded
channel — backpressure lives here, explicitly.
tokeira_runtime_lane_queue_wait_seconds
tokeira_runtime_lane_submit_duration_seconds (end-to-end)
eager start · pre-commit
On Start, a waiting poller is reserved before the commit —
the broker interaction that happens ahead of durability,
so delivery is instant when the commit lands.
tokeira_runtime_broker_sync_match_total
vs tokeira_runtime_broker_non_sync_match_total
3 · Load — or don't
The lane cache (4096 entries, 60s idle) serves hot runs and
bypasses storage entirely; a miss reads one workflow_hot row.
tokeira_storage_load_run_duration_seconds
cache evicts on OCC conflict — correctness first
4 · The pure kernel
A synchronous, deterministic decision — no I/O, no await.
Its cost is compute; its span is the instrument.
span: kernel.transition
a no-op transition ends the path here — nothing written
5 · One fenced transaction
Seven tables in one txn: hot state, history batch, dedupe,
activity state + dispatch, timers, current-execution, the
visibility snapshot. Fences first; a Commit-class permit gates entry.
tokeira_storage_commit_transition_duration_seconds
tokeira_storage_dsql_statement_duration_seconds{statement=…}
6 · Publish — inside your latency
Dispatch fans out to the brokers and is awaited before the
reply: broker time is part of what the caller feels. Failure
is non-fatal — sweepers recover — but success is on the clock.
tokeira_runtime_broker_publish_total · _queue_depth
7 · Reply
After the durable outcome, after publish — the caller hears
a truth that already survived a crash. WFT timeout tracking
arms inline here too — real per-commit work.
tokeira_runtime_lane_processing_duration_seconds
OCC conflict → evict cache → reload → re-apply, at most 5 attempts
tokeira_runtime_occ_retry_total · tokeira_storage_dsql_occ_conflict_total
side path: speculative WFTs — precise in-memory timers, zero DSQL commits, never on this page's clock
tokeira_runtime_query_buffer_wait_seconds (buffered consistent queries — the other synchronous barrier)
THE PLUMBING BENEATH THE COMMIT
Connection permits, by class
The commit hop acquires a Commit-class permit — its wait is a first-class stage of your
latency, isolated from reads, projection, control, and maintenance by design.
tokeira_dsql_class_permit_wait_duration_seconds · _pool_class_in_use · _class_waiters
tokeira_dsql_connection_leak_suspects · _connection_checkout_overdue_seconds
The projection consumer runs off-clock
The snapshot row is written inside the commit — but its consumers never touch this path:
worker lag is a quality signal, not a latency stage.
tokeira_projection_worker_lag_records · _checkpoint_lag_seconds · _sink_error_total
THE LEVERS — WHAT ACTUALLY MOVES THE SHAPE
Four knobs, one warning
bundle_count — independent ownership cells. DEFAULT IS 1: out of the box, a single lease row serializes ownership. The first lever to check at scale.
lane_count (default 32) — more local executors; per-run order is preserved by construction.
id spread — deterministic wide UUIDs spread runs across bundles and lanes; blake3 home hashing spreads commits.
reservoir — target_ready 50 · lifetime 10m ± 2m jitter · guard 45s · hard cutoff 15m · creation 100/s burst 1000 (embedded: 8 conns, 8/s burst 2).
Every lever's effect shows up in the metrics above — turn one, watch the shape move, keep the evidence.
The rule this page lives by:
latency claims belong to benchmarks on your hardware — this page tells you where to point the ruler, never what it will read.
Companions: the lane commit pipeline (the same journey, taught) · the connection reservoir (the permits' world) · the delivery plane (where publish goes).
